title: Healthcare Executive
description: Promote Gravionne's products to healthcare professionals and retail partners, driving awareness, building relationships, and achieving sales targets within assigned territories.
about: Gravionne is a premium health and wellness brand dedicated to improving lives through science, innovation, and care. We offer high-quality functional health and wellness products designed to support healthy motherhood, well-nourished childhood, and enhance daily vitality—helping individuals and families enjoy lasting wellbeing.
roleOverview: The Healthcare Executive will play a key role in promoting Gravionne's products to healthcare professionals and retail partners, driving awareness, building relationships, and achieving sales targets within assigned territories.
responsibilities: Promote products to healthcare professionals, including doctors and pharmacists
Generate product demand through effective communication and engagement
Ensure product availability and visibility in assigned pharmacies and outlets
Achieve sales targets within the assigned territory
Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and retail partners
Collect orders and coordinate with distribution channels
Provide regular field reports and market feedback
qualifications: Science background at Higher Secondary level preferred
requirements: Minimum 1 year of experience in sales or field-based roles (healthcare, FMCG, or related sectors preferred)
Self-motivated, target-driven, and willing to work in a field environment
Ability to build professional relationships and work independently
